scientific_question: Among station-years where Thalassia testudinum is explicitly recorded present, do source-year within-station frequency and percent cover add out-of-time information about next-year explicitly recorded zero-cover state?

response_semantics.unsurveyed_station_year: absent cover-table station-year or station-year with fewer than two valid focal quadrat measurements; excluded, never converted to zero
response_semantics.recorded_presence: at least one valid focal quadrat measurement > 0
response_semantics.recorded_zero_cover: at least two valid focal quadrat measurements and every valid focal measurement equals 0
response_semantics.transition_target: same stable station in immediately following calendar year with an eligible annual state
response_semantics.interpretation: recorded cover-state instability, not demographic extinction

parser.header_resolution: deterministic normalized semantic aliases; exactly one valid mapping required per annual table
parser.normalized_header: lowercase; trim; replace % with percent; collapse non-alphanumeric runs to underscore
parser.wide_focal_rule: exactly one header cell whose normalized text contains 'thalassia'; because the selected table is predeclared QuadratPercentCover, that cell is interpreted as focal percent cover
parser.other_missing_tokens: blank cell allowed as missing; any nonblank focal-cover token other than numeric 0-100 or numeric 9999 is terminal
parser.stable_node_id: if a region column is resolved use normalized region + '::' + station; otherwise station
parser.focal_frequency: number of valid focal quadrats with cover >0 divided by number of valid focal quadrats
parser.focal_mean_cover: mean focal percent cover across all valid focal quadrats including explicit zero

model.split: strict walk-forward by target year; target y trains only transitions with target_year < y
model.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler fit inside each training year split only
model.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') fit inside each training year split only

scoring.primary_aggregation: unweighted mean of target-year log losses
scoring.favorable: augmented macro log loss < baseline AND augmented wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
scoring.adverse: baseline macro log loss < augmented AND baseline wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
secondary: pooled ROC AUC if both classes

one_shot_access.response_access: for each year request only the selected QuadratPercentCover ZIP entry local header/name-extra bytes and compressed entry payload by exact HTTP Range; do not read any other ZIP entry payload

no_rescue: Do not switch focal species after selected cover entry access.
Do not add canopy height, water quality, or another biological state to rescue the result.
Do not interpret 9999, blank, unsurveyed station-year, or absent focal measurement as zero.
Do not change header aliases, annualization, node definition, outcome, estimability minima, learner, split, metric, or decision after selected cover payload access.
Any parser/schema/estimability failure after cover-table access terminates v2 with zero predictive evidence if no valid predictive score is produced.
Retain 2017-2018 Hurricane Harvey context if present; do not remove an adverse year post-outcome.
